nina: quick sync on making cost attribution resilient across external id rotations.

ben: observed spikes of unknown_tenant when auth rotated keys. need durable resolution.

omar: two options: store tiny breadcrumb in trace header or maintain tenant_map that queries join against.

vela: breadcrumb = simple but increases envelope size and complicates rotation. tenant_map = extra join cost + cache pressure.

nina: proposal: write 12-byte breadcrumb at edge when available, and also publish mapping events to tenant_map (materialized view) with TTL=90d. queries try breadcrumb first, then tenant_map.

ben: how to handle ordering when trace arrives before map write?

omar: fallback: enqueue reconciliation job; queries mark as unresolved and include resolved_by metadata when later fixed.

vela: metrics: map_hit, map_miss, backfill_progress, reconcile_errors. alert if miss_rate > 4% for 3h.

ingest-bot: backfill job scheduled -> bf-7054322001.

nina: I'll draft RFC with proto for tenant_map, canary checklist, and legal access controls. owners: nina (RFC), vela (legal), omar (runtime).
